bio: Resort mornings, rooftop pools and long lunches by the sea. Swimwear, sunsets and slow summer living. Adults only.
avatar: Portrait of a smiling woman in her early 30s with sun-kissed shoulders and wavy hair, wearing sunglasses pushed up and a white linen shirt, golden hour at a beach club, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a luxury beach club at sunset with white loungers, a turquoise pool and palm trees, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: Summer, slowly
videos: Swimsuit season, packing for the coast

videos.title: Infinity pool, early morning
videos.description: The pool before anyone arrives: still water, white loungers, a first coffee.
videos.still: Wide photograph of an empty infinity pool at a seaside resort at sunrise with white loungers and the sea beyond, soft pink light, no people, no text
videos.motion: The water surface ripples gently, light glitters, slow gentle push-in toward the horizon.

videos.title: Beach-club sunset, one cocktail
videos.description: A sunset toast on the terrace.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a woman in a flowing sundress seen from behind at a beach club terrace holding a cocktail toward a vivid sunset, tasteful, fully clothed, no face, no text
videos.motion: The sunset light shifts, her dress and hair move in the breeze, cocktail glass glints, slow camera drift.

videos.title: Swimsuit season, packing for the coast
videos.description: Straw hats, folded linens and a swimsuit — a suitcase before the trip.
videos.still: Vertical top-down photograph of an open suitcase packed with folded linen clothes, a straw hat, sunglasses and a bikini top, sand-coloured bed sheet, no people, tasteful, no text
videos.motion: Sunlight shifts slowly across the suitcase and a sheer curtain moves in the breeze, subtle top-down drift.

videos.title: Yacht lunch, Mediterranean
videos.description: A long table on deck, white wine and the sea passing by.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a long lunch table on a yacht deck with white tablecloth, wine glasses and fruit, blue sea beyond, people seen from a distance in summer clothes, tasteful, no text
videos.motion: The yacht glides across the blue sea, sunlight sparkles on the water, tablecloth flutters, slow camera drift.
